name: updateLocationField
description: Changes a location field's label, type or options, found by its label.

label.description: The current label of the field to change.

newLabel.description: The field's new label. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newType.description: What the field holds from now on; quick actions hold only an email, phone or URL. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newRequired.description: Whether every location must fill it in. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

newAllowCustomLabel.description: Whether each location may give it its own label. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

callback.description: Runs when the field is changed.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, such as no field having that label or nothing to change.

result.description: The location field, as it is now.

type.description: What the field holds: EMAIL, PHONE, URL, TEXT or RICH_TEXT.

section.description: Where it shows: quickActions or content.

required.description: Whether every location must fill it in.

allowCustomLabel.description: Whether each location may give it its own label.
